title: Lot-Class Share of the Water Second-Block Bound — Utility Pass-Through Service Rate Sheet
content:
**Rate provision.** For the water usage charge on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, the second-block bound used is the schedule's second-block bound times the lot share of the lot class of the Home-Site Lease the account serves: 140 percent (a multiplier of 1.4) for a Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site or a Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site, and 120 percent (a multiplier of 1.2) for a Standard Multi-Section Home Site or a Preferred Multi-Section Home Site. A single-section home site takes no lot share under this provision.

## Lot share by Home-Site Lease lot class

| Lot class of the Home-Site Lease | Lot share of the second-block bound |
|---|---|
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 140 percent |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 140 percent |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 120 percent |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 120 percent |
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | none |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | none |

## Second-block bound used (illustration from the schedule figures)

| Service schedule | Schedule's second-block bound | At 140 percent | At 120 percent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Submetered Water Schedule | 10.00 kgal | 14.00 kgal | 12.00 kgal |
| Submetered Water & Sewer, Natural Gas and Propane Schedules | 8.00 kgal | 11.20 kgal | 9.60 kgal |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 12.00 kgal | 16.80 kgal | 14.40 kgal |

**Example (hypothetical).** A Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site on the Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule using 10.50 kgal has nothing in the third block, because its second-block bound is 8.00 times 140 percent, 11.20 kgal.
